# New World Encyclopedia

> > A comprehensive online encyclopedia providing collaborative knowledge across science, humanities, religion, and culture with integrated user feedback.

New World Encyclopedia offers encyclopedia articles spanning diverse topics from linguistics and earth sciences to theology and astronomy. The site features a feedback system enabling community discussion and improvement of encyclopedia entries.

## Key Topics

- Encyclopedia articles
- User feedback and discussion
- Science and natural sciences
- Geology and earth sciences
- Astronomy and constellations
- Linguistics and grammar
- Theology and religious history
- Geography and continents
- Community collaboration
- Article improvement
- RSS feeds

## User Feedback & Discussion

- [Adjective - Article Feedback](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/feedback/adjective/): User feedback and discussion page for the Adjective encyclopedia article
- [Geology - Article Feedback](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/feedback/geology/): User feedback and discussion page for the Geology encyclopedia article
- [Continent - Article Feedback](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/feedback/continent/): User feedback and discussion page for the Continent encyclopedia article
- [Eutyches - Article Feedback](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/feedback/eutyches/): User feedback and discussion page for the Eutyches encyclopedia article
- [Constellation - Article Feedback](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/feedback/constellation/): User feedback and discussion page for the Constellation article
